methods_quotes.q: A periodic regression model incorporating a robust regression procedure is used to estimate a seasonal baseline for P&I deaths.
An increase of 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline for P&I deaths is considered the epidemic threshold.
baseline and threshold levels of P&I mortality are estimated using the previous 5 years' mortality data.
